bug_info.bug_desc: The HFENCE decode is an independent `if (CVA6Cfg.RVH)` after the SFENCE.VMA match. A recognized SFENCE can therefore continue into the hypervisor decode/fallback chain instead of terminating the mutually exclusive SYSTEM decode, allowing the later logic to overwrite or miss the correct legality result.
bug_info.fix_hint: Make the RVH-dependent HFENCE decode an `else if` continuation of the SFENCE.VMA branch so only one SYSTEM instruction family handles the encoding.

bug_info.bug_desc: With RVH enabled, the default SYSTEM decode has no final illegal-instruction fallback after the HFENCE branches. An unsupported funct7 can leave illegal_instr deasserted.
bug_info.fix_hint: Make the HFENCE branches mutually exclusive and set illegal_instr in their final else.

bug_info.bug_desc: The default SYSTEM decode has no final illegal fallback when the encoding is not SFENCE.VMA and the hypervisor extension is disabled. An unmatched HFENCE-style encoding can therefore leave the decoder's legal default in place instead of raising an illegal-instruction exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: Use one mutually exclusive SFENCE/HFENCE decode chain and set illegal_instr in its final fallback when no supported encoding matches.

bug_info.bug_desc: With RVH enabled, the hypervisor load/store funct7 case has no default branch. An unsupported encoding can leave illegal_instr deasserted.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a default branch that sets illegal_instr in the hypervisor load/store funct7 case.

bug_info.bug_desc: For SYSTEM instructions with `funct3=3'b100`, the hypervisor load/store decode is skipped when RVH is disabled, but there is no fallback that marks the encoding illegal. Hypervisor-only instructions can therefore pass through a non-hypervisor configuration without an illegal-instruction exception.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add an `else` to the RVH-gated hypervisor load/store block that sets `illegal_instr` when the extension is disabled.
